description: FUNCTION BYTE-LENGTH (ISO 15.14) - the byte-counting twin of FUNCTION LENGTH (15.50); the D7 byte-vs-position distinction. LIVE (P11 Step 7): a COMPILE-TIME FOLD (BindByteLengthFold) over DataItem.ByteWidth, which pins WiseOwl COBOL's implementor-defined per-usage byte widths (13.18.60 leaves them to the implementor): DISPLAY/BIT 1 byte per position, NATIONAL 2 bytes per position (UTF-16), BINARY/PACKED/BINARY-CHAR..DOUBLE the StorageWidth, float 4/8, index/pointer/object-reference 8. Runtime-length shapes (ref-mod/ODO/ANY LENGTH) stay loud by name. 2002 introduction; below 2002 the D8 catalog window rejects by name+edition (COBOL1502).
vcr: M2 catalog BYTE-LENGTH; 2002 introduction (the byte-length function - derive from the 2002 standard; absent from the 1989 Intrinsic Function Module set)
